inputs.sequence_prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Picture 1>: Celes performing Maria: the exact blonde adult woman with blue hair ribbon, ivory puff-sleeved opera gown, blue waist sash and blue trim. Keep her face and costume.
<Picture 2>: Setzer: the exact mature man with long silver hair, facial scar, black long coat with blue collar, gold brocade waistcoat, ivory cravat, black gloves and tall boots.
<Picture 3>: Locke: the exact adult man with brown hair, blue bandana, short dark jacket, cream embroidered shirt, blue trousers and tan boots.

summary:
A single continuous fifteen-second cinematic live-action opera scene with real actors and the approved practical character designs.

retention_analysis:
Retain the exact referenced faces, hairstyles, costumes, proportions and materials. Images define identity; directed blocking determines the scene. No unlisted actors or face replacements.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] (0-15 seconds) Quiet physical acting in one continuous live-action wide shot. At blue hour, a solid short wooden boarding bridge connects an open doorway in the STONE WALL OF THE OPERA THEATRE directly to the edge of the moored Blackjack airship. The theatre wall with its arched doorway, red curtain and steady warm interior light occupies the LEFT HALF OF THE BACKGROUND for the entire shot. This is a theatre building, not a wooden ship cabin. The bridge runs diagonally from that doorway in the background left to the ship deck in the foreground right, with solid planks and waist-high rails on both sides. The bridge meets the deck without a gap or step. One waist-high rectangular wooden gate at the deck end is fully open inward from the beginning, attached to a fixed brass hinge post. The gate remains attached to that post. The airship deck has dark wood planks, brass railings with wooden tops, a warm fixed lantern and a wooden cabin door at the far RIGHT EDGE. All of this geography is established at the first frame and remains unchanged. No sail or other ship fills the background. No sea or ship departure. Natural faces and fabric, steady diffuse evening light, stable warm lantern light.
At the start Setzer and Celes are already walking side by side near the middle of the short bridge. Setzer is on the LEFT SIDE OF CELES; his LEFT gloved hand holds her RIGHT bare hand, exactly as they left the stage. Locke is clearly visible at the theatre doorway behind them from the first frame, watching their departure. He carries the SAME plain round wooden theatre shield from the opera fight in his LEFT hand, hanging near his left knee: straight parallel wood boards, simple wood construction, no metal rim, no metal boss, no painted emblem. It remains the same size and construction in every frame. His belt weapon stays sheathed. Celes has empty hands except for Setzer's hand; her roses remain in the theatre. The other hand of each person is free. Setzer's cards stay in his coat.
0-6 seconds: Setzer and Celes walk three purposeful steps together along the bridge, through the open gate and onto the deck. Their boots and shoes remain supported by the solid planks; knees and hips transfer weight naturally, coats and gown follow the movement. The camera makes a small smooth backward move on the deck, keeping the entire bridge and the theatre doorway visible. Celes looks back directly at Locke as they clear the gate. Locke notices her look and starts following them along the visible bridge.
6-11 seconds: Celes releases Setzer's hand and stops beside the hinge post. She holds the upper edge of the ALREADY OPEN gate with her free left palm, keeping the same panel steady while watching Locke approach. There is no close-and-reopen cycle. Setzer walks two more steps toward the right-hand cabin, with his back three-quarters to the bridge. Locke follows the same visible route as the couple, passes through the clear opening and steps onto the deck carrying the shield continuously in his left hand. His shield stays away from the rails and gate. Celes and the gate do not change positions while he passes.
11-15 seconds: Locke stops beside Celes, one step inside the gate. Celes takes her hand off the gate after he clears it. Hearing the final boot step, Setzer turns his head and then his shoulders back toward them. Celes holds his gaze calmly; Locke watches Setzer, shield still lowered beside his left leg. The three now face one another in a clearly readable triangle on the same deck. The camera settles. Closed resting mouths, restrained breathing, no speaking or singing gestures. The theatre doorway, short bridge, open gate and deck stay in the same physical positions. No new character, no disappearance, no internal edit or change of location.

overall_soundscape:
Only dry boot contacts on wood, soft cloth rustle, quiet evening wind and a faint wooden gate hinge creak. No human vocal track. No words, whispers, crowd chatter, narration, singing or music. Keep all mouths resting closed throughout this quiet physical action.
